name: the-work-owners-come-from-one-list
breaks: a second hand-kept list of the work owners comes back. SwiftUI TRAPS on a missing environment value, so the copy that falls behind does not fail a check, it crashes whatever screen reads the missing owner and the run blames an unrelated test (#718, L41, L96). The anchor gained the line below it in #1025, when the Settings window started taking the same owners and `.withAppOwners(owners)` stopped naming one place
